name: LAKENETWORKS
notes:
Our network highlights


* AS6517 applies strict import and export filtering policies across transit, peering and downstream sessions.

* AS6517 rejects RPKI invalid routes on transit and downstream sessions.

* AS6517 blocks bogon prefixes, bogon ASNs, default routes and invalid prefix lengths on transit import/export policies.

* AS6517 filters BGP paths longer than 50 ASNs.

* AS6517 only accepts downstream prefixes explicitly included in the allowed prefix set.

* AS6517 automatically generates IRR-based prefix filters every 6 hours, using data from AFRINIC, ARIN, APNIC, LACNIC and RIPE.

* AS6517 treats RADB as a high-risk IRR source and requires manual verification before using RADB data.

* AS6517 supports informational BGP communities to identify route origin, including local, transit, IX route server, peering, downstream and iBGP learned routes.

* AS6517 supports action BGP communities for traffic engineering, including no-export controls and AS-path prepending toward specific ASNs or route classes.

* AS6517 maintains direct upstream connectivity with InvisionTech, Hurricane Electric, XeniaGroup and Revolution Provider.

* AS6517 is present at MINAP and NineIX for public peering.

* AS6517 can evaluate private interconnection and partnership proposals in Milan through Telnet and Seeweb.

* Current upstream capacity includes 40 Gbps via InvisionTech and additional 10 Gbit transit capacity through Hurricane Electric, XeniaGroup and Revolution Provider.

* AS6517 encourages peering with networks present at MINAP and NineIX.
